summary:
Bubo Reader is a minimal static RSS/Atom/JSON feed reader that builds a single HTML page. I saved 2 views:
1. feed-list: the entry page with every feed closed. Feeds are grouped under headings (Developer News, Blogs, Design, Reading & Misc, My GitHub Projects), and each feed is a closed disclosure showing its title and URL. Because views are captured full-page, this one should also include the Errors section and the 'Last updated' footer at the bottom.
2. feeds-expanded: the same page with two feeds opened (Changelog Master Feed and Simon Willison's Weblog), showing their dated lists of article links.
The app has no other screens, routes or dialogs, so these two views cover its whole interface. Both replayed with a similarity of 1.00.
